purpose: Matched benchmark of anytime PESS outer search against the unchanged Static MILP and Master-Oracle implementations.

model.objective: sum_i w_i max_{P in MaximalMatchings(H_i[M])} |alpha_i + sum_{e in P} b_{e,i}|
model.resource_choice: one unordered global labeled resource set M
model.maintenance: additive nonnegative proxy sum_e cost_e <= B; zero-cost candidates retained
model.matching_semantics: labeled maximal matching, never maximum-cardinality matching
model.task_aggregation: independent task-wise maxima followed by weighted sum
model.loss: positive pre-clamp absolute log-error model; all frozen coefficients are finite exact rational stand-ins
model.scope: model-level synthetic evidence; no PostgreSQL behavior or physical maintenance claim

corpus.generation: hand-authored deterministic JSON fixtures; no post-hoc filtering, resampling, or cherry-picking

small.objective_evaluation: independent exact Fraction enumeration of every feasible outer subset and every selected-graph labeled maximal matching

medium.objective_evaluation: independent exact Fraction maximal-matching enumeration for every reported incumbent; full outer enumeration is a reference only where feasible

exploratory_stress.objective_evaluation: independent exact Fraction selected-graph maximal-matching enumeration for reported incumbents; unresolved timeout/orderings are UNCERTIFIED

predeclared_counterexample_checks: At least one fixed corpus row must exhibit a nonmonotone greedy trap under the deterministic add-only greedy control; if none does, report the requirement as unmet rather than filtering or replacing rows.

At least one fixed corpus stratum must have the empty/singleton/greedy control or Static MILP strictly better than the specialized treatment on an independently certified objective or checkpoint; failures must be retained.

methods.truth: independent Fraction exhaustive reference on small; exact selected-graph evaluator on medium/stress
controls: best feasible singleton with deterministic lexicographic tie break
deterministic add-only greedy, selecting the lexicographically first best strictly improving feasible addition; stop on no improvement; zero-cost candidates are considered

generic_neighborhood.name: basic ADD/DELETE/1-for-1-SWAP local search
generic_neighborhood.moves: all globally budget-feasible neighbors in lexicographic resource order
generic_neighborhood.acceptance: strictly lower independently certified objective only
generic_neighborhood.termination: first-improvement pass repeats until no strict improvement or full-process deadline
generic_neighborhood.plateau: retain incumbent; no equal-objective move; report plateau and evaluated neighbors

treatment.name: PESS witness-sensitivity ordering plus canonical task-evaluation cache
treatment.hypothesis: ordering candidates by deterministic descending task-wise signed-extrema sensitivity, with lexicographic tie break, reaches a better independently certified incumbent sooner at a matched wall-time budget than the same neighborhood with lexicographic ordering
treatment.falsification: the hypothesis is false if the predeclared checkpoint aggregate shows no material improvement or if the treatment loses on fixed strata; all losses remain reported

exact_references: unchanged ess-advisor Static strengthened conditional MILP
unchanged ess-advisor Master-Oracle with precompute/cache switches recorded separately

fairness.objective_target: first independently certified incumbent at or below min(OPT + 1/10, 1.10 * max(OPT, 1)) for small; no target claim when OPT is unavailable
fairness.threads: single-threaded process; HiGHS thread setting/default recorded and not changed between methods
fairness.memory_cap: NOT ENFORCED in v1; process RSS recorded where available
fairness.timeout_scope: one full invocation including preprocessing, objective evaluations, cache management, solver calls, validation, and serialization
fairness.total_pilot_cap: bounded to the listed five fixtures, three repetitions, and listed checkpoints
fairness.comparison_rule: compare only independently certified original PESS objectives; solver-reported numerical bounds are labeled separately and never upgraded to exact truth

advisor_gate_a.adapter: research-side only; no ess-advisor or ess-postgresql modifications
required_checks: returned selections are globally budget feasible
returned selections and original PESS losses agree with independent Fraction truth on tiny inputs
all solver statuses, tolerances, primal/dual bounds, warnings, and timings are retained
total_time_limit bounds full solver invocation, not only inner calls
advisor_gate_a.failure_policy: if Static cannot run faithfully, Gate A is NO-GO/INCONCLUSIVE and no speedup claim; if Master-Oracle cannot run faithfully, record concrete blocker and NOT EXECUTED

protocol_chronology.required_before: any treatment or comparator result comparison

protocol_chronology.required_after: Gate A pass or explicitly scoped INCONCLUSIVE decision

change_control: v1 is preserved; any change to inputs, stopping rule, checkpoints, repetitions, objective target, or tier scope requires a new versioned v2 protocol and cannot overwrite v1 evidence
